# FORScan PIDs

FORScan lists 1,148 PIDs for the Focus RS Mk3 across 20 modules. The names, descriptions and units are on the module pages below; **the diagnostic address (DID) is known for only 33 of them**, the ones openRS_ marks as monitored. To read any other one you need its DID, see [Finding and Confirming PIDs](Finding-and-Confirming-PIDs.md).

## PIDs with a known DID

Formulas use `A` for the first data byte after the DID and `B` for the second. "openRS_ field" is the name openRS_ stores the value under. A blank formula means the catalogue has none; [Diagnostic DIDs](Diagnostic-DIDs.md) has the formulas openRS_ uses for the tyre pressures, sensor IDs and odometer.

The Unit column is FORScan's, and openRS_'s formula doesn't always produce it: `FRP` is stored in psi (`hpFuelRailPsi`), and the boost (`TCBP`, `TCBP_DSD`), throttle (`ETC_ACT`, `ETC_DSD`) and wastegate formulas are labelled with different units or sizes in different openRS_ files. See "Where the sources disagree" on the [Diagnostic DIDs](Diagnostic-DIDs.md) page.
